## Purpose
An empty seed MCP server registry: `{"servers": []}`.

## Settings that matter
The `servers` list. Each entry is `{name, url, protocol, enabled, description, registered_at}`.

## Read by
`services/mcp_manager`, only when `MCP_REGISTRY_PATH=mcp_servers/mcp_registry.json`. The code default is `db/mcp_registry.json`.

## Environment-specific differences
None.

## Nuances and gotchas
`mcp_manager` writes the registry back to whichever path is configured, so with this path the tracked file would be modified at run time.

## How to rebuild this file
`{"servers": []}`.
